items.title: CISA Warns of Exploited Gitea Vulnerability
items.description: CVE-2026-60004 is a remote code execution vulnerability patched by Gitea developers in late July with the release of version 1.27.1. The post CISA Warns of Exploited Gitea Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Multiple OpenSSL Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Corrupt Heap Memory
items.description: OpenSSL has issued a fresh security advisory disclosing seven vulnerabilities across its cryptographic library, ranging from a heap-corrupting write bug to memory-exhaustion flaws in its QUIC and DTLS implementations. The flaws affect widely deployed branches, including OpenSSL 4.0, 3.6, 3.5, 3.4, and 3.0, and, in some cases, the legacy 1.1.1 line, making patching a priority […] The post…
